Delete line 311: ```python requires_explanation=bool(card.get("requires_explanation")), ``` The constructor call after the change: ```python fc = Flashcard( course_id=course_id, unit_id=unit_id, topic_id=topic_id, front=card["front"], back=card["back"], ) ``` - [ ] **Step 3: Remove requires_explanation from units_topics.py** In `app/routes/units_topics.py`, find the `Flashcard(...)` constructor at line 239. Delete line 244: ```python requires_explanation=bool(card.get("requires_explanation")), ``` The constructor call after the change: ```python fc = Flashcard( course_id=course.id, unit_id=unit_id, topic_id=topic_id, front=card["front"], back=card["back"], ) ``` - [ ] **Step 4: Replace drill.html with simplified template** Overwrite the entire contents of `app/templates/flashcards/drill.html` with: ```html {% extends "base.html" %} {% block title %}Drill{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Flashcard Drill

Question

{{ card.front }}

Click or press Space to reveal answer

Answer

{{ card.back }}

{% if unit_filter %} {% endif %}
{% endblock %} ``` - [ ] **Step 5: Generate Alembic migration** ```bash alembic revision --autogenerate -m "drop_requires_explanation_from_flashcard" ``` Open the newly created file in `alembic/versions/`. It will have a name like `<12-char-hash>_drop_requires_explanation_from_flashcard.py`. Verify (and if needed correct) the `upgrade` and `downgrade` functions to match: ```python def upgrade() -> None: op.drop_column("flashcard", "requires_explanation") def downgrade() -> None: op.add_column( "flashcard", sa.Column( "requires_explanation", sa.Boolean(), nullable=False, server_default=sa.text("false"), ), ) ``` - [ ] **Step 6: Run the migration** ```bash alembic upgrade head ``` Expected: completes with no errors. The `requires_explanation` column is gone from the `flashcard` table. - [ ] **Step 7: Run the flashcard test suite** ```bash pytest tests/test_flashcards.py -v ``` Expected: all tests **PASS**, including the two new regression tests. - [ ] **Step 8: Run the full test suite** ```bash pytest --tb=short -q ``` Expected: all tests pass. No regressions from other tests referencing `requires_explanation`. - [ ] **Step 9: Commit** ```bash git add app/models/tracking.py \ app/services/background.py \ app/routes/units_topics.py \ app/templates/flashcards/drill.html \ tests/test_flashcards.py \ alembic/versions/*drop_requires_explanation*.py git commit -m "feat: remove explain-why flashcard type — simplify drill to pure flip-rate loop" ``` ## Context This is part of removing the explain-why flashcard type from StudyEngine. The feature was a category confusion — explain-why flashcards tried to do graded construction (a quiz-level task) inside the FSRS flashcard loop (a recognition/retrieval loop). The decision is to remove it entirely. Task 1 already added two RED regression tests: 1. `test_flashcard_model_has_no_requires_explanation` — FAILS because `requires_explanation` column still exists 2. `test_drill_never_shows_textarea` — FAILS because the template still renders a textarea for "Explain why..." card fronts Your job is to make both tests GREEN. The test DB was just reset to a clean state — `alembic upgrade head` should run cleanly. **Important:** The model field removal and template simplification MUST be committed together — the template references `card.requires_explanation` and will break if the model field is removed without the template being updated in the same session. def test_flashcard_requires_explanation_defaults_false(db_session):
    """New flashcards have requires_explanation=False by default."""
    _user, course, unit, _topic = _setup_course(db_session)

    card = Flashcard(
        course_id=course.id,
        unit_id=unit.id,
        front="What is X?",
        back="Y",
    )
    db_session.add(card)
    db_session.commit()

    assert card.requires_explanation is False


def test_flashcard_requires_explanation_true(db_session):
    """Flashcard requires_explanation can be set to True and persists."""
    _user, course, unit, _topic = _setup_course(db_session)

    card = Flashcard(
        course_id=course.id,
        unit_id=unit.id,
        front="Explain why X happens.",
        back="Because Y.",
        requires_explanation=True,
    )
    db_session.add(card)
    db_session.commit()

    fetched = db_session.get(Flashcard, card.id)
    assert fetched.requires_explanation is True
